_doc: The in-game UI's look (docs/adr/0009-user-interface.md). Read by tools/ui/*.py, tools/ue/import_ui.py and the game (UMRUIStyle); MRUIReload in the console re-reads it (sizes and colours; a new art variant needs tools/ue/import_ui.ps1). Sizes are in original-client pixels; ui_scale turns them into Slate units at 1080p (the engine's DPI curve scales from there). text_scale multiplies every font on top of ui_scale. frame_scale sizes a frame's pieces (edge: the dialog's iron border; view: the gold-ball corners and the transparent band they reach into, as around the original's 3D view).
